durable.evidence: A test relay in one process (test/lib/CountingRelay.ps1) that keeps its mailboxes in memory and counts every request made of it: it is never chosen by a caller that requires anything.

realtime.evidence: Its watch does wait, and returns within its 20 ms poll of a put; it declines the claim because it exists to be counted, not picked (test/lib/CountingRelay.ps1).

reach.remote.evidence: It lives in the test's own process; nothing else can reach it.

trim.on.ack.evidence: An ack is counted, and what it covers is no longer handed over; it declines the claim because it exists to be counted, not picked.
